title: New class: the Summoner
changes: A new hero joins the fire: the Summoner, a masked occultist who fights through elemental golems.
Attune turns the element (fire, frost, venom, storm), then Elemental Golem calls one: up to 2 fight for you, monsters and rival heroes alike.
Conjured Blade and Conjured Armour arm you; at level 10 the Colossus fuses your golems into one giant for 30 seconds.
Remember: no magic inside Oakvale. Call your golems outside the stockade.
